create_cache_instance: create a Cache instance to store and manage Batch entries by batch_id
set_cache_entry: set a Batch entry in the Cache using its batch_id as the key
pop_cache_entry: pop and retrieve a Batch entry from the Cache by its batch_id
delete_cache_entry: delete a Batch entry from the Cache and free CUDA memory if available
clear_all_cache: clear all entries from the Cache and free CUDA memory for each removed entry
